F4_candidate_definition: A DUE_ASOF event that passes or remains unresolved-capable-of-passing every PIT eligibility component other than F4 resolution/objective/ambiguity itself. F4 ambiguity is evaluated on this candidate set so ambiguity cannot remove itself from its own zero-ambiguity test.

bounds.rate: PASS iff confirmed_pass/N >= threshold; FAIL iff (confirmed_pass+unresolved_capable)/N < threshold; else INDETERMINATE
bounds.zero_problem: confirmed problem => FAIL; zero problems plus any unresolved capable of hiding a problem => INDETERMINATE; otherwise PASS
bounds.count_floor: PASS iff lower>=floor; FAIL iff upper<floor; else INDETERMINATE
bounds.median: Unresolved observations are assigned 0 hours for the lower-bound median and +infinity for the upper-bound median. PASS/FAIL only when both threshold implications are identified; otherwise INDETERMINATE.

overall_family_feasibility: ELIGIBLE_TO_DRAFT_W3_PROTOCOL iff F1 through F9 all PASS; any FAIL => NO_GO_CURRENT_PROTOCOL; otherwise INDETERMINATE_PENDING_EVIDENCE
claim_limit: Passing F1-F9 establishes operational feasibility to draft W3, not alpha, predictive skill, power, or economic usefulness.
